data_sources.service: HTTP byte-range read of M3 L2 RFL + L1B LOC
processing: pixel located via L1B LOC backplane (M3G20090609T183254_V03_RDN); nearest pixel line 13054, sample 130
window 41x41 px range-read from L2 RFL; pixels > 10.0 km from target masked
bands < 540 nm and > 2600 nm excluded; values <= 0, >= 1.5, -999 or non-finite masked
limitations: M3 L2 reflectance includes an empirical thermal correction; residual thermal emission can affect the 2 µm region on warm, low-latitude terrain.
M3 global-mode spatial sampling is ~140 m/pixel (100 km orbit) or ~280 m/pixel (200 km orbit).
L2 photometric correction uses a lunar topography model; steep slopes and high incidence angles degrade the correction.
Pixels within the window are spatially correlated, so the detection test is optimistic.

mineralogy.method: M3 L2 reflectance window; band depths over valid pixels (see indicator definitions)

indicators.name: IBD1000
indicators.definition: Integrated band depth 789-1308 nm, linear continuum ~699-1579 nm
indicators.reference: Mustard et al. (2011) JGR 116, E00G12 (M3 integrated band depths)
indicators.sensitive_to: Fe2+ crystal-field absorptions near 1 µm (pyroxene, olivine, Fe-bearing glass)
indicators.threshold_basis: statistical screening: window mean > 3 x standard error (effective n = pixels/25 for spatial correlation), median > 0 and >= 60% of pixels positive. Detects a positive band depth; not a mineral abundance or identification
indicators.interpretation: Positive absorption detected (statistical screening: window mean > 3 x standard error (effective n = pixels/25 for spatial correlation), median > 0 and >= 60% of pixels positive. Detects a positive band depth; not a mineral abundance or identification).

indicators.name: IBD2000
indicators.definition: Integrated band depth 1658-2498 nm, linear continuum ~1579-2538 nm
indicators.reference: Mustard et al. (2011) JGR 116, E00G12 (M3 integrated band depths)
indicators.sensitive_to: Fe2+ absorption near 2 µm (pyroxene; absent in olivine)
indicators.threshold_basis: statistical screening: window mean > 3 x standard error (effective n = pixels/25 for spatial correlation), median > 0 and >= 60% of pixels positive. Detects a positive band depth; not a mineral abundance or identification
indicators.interpretation: Positive absorption detected (statistical screening: window mean > 3 x standard error (effective n = pixels/25 for spatial correlation), median > 0 and >= 60% of pixels positive. Detects a positive band depth; not a mineral abundance or identification).

earth_analogs.method: Euclidean distance over directly comparable band depths (legacy definition)
earth_analogs.reference_library: GEØ.IA terrestrial EMIT band-depth reference library v1.0.0 (90 sites)
approximate_proxies: IBD1000 (vs EMIT 1 µm depth: same absorption, different integration)
IBD2000 (vs EMIT 2 µm depth: same absorption, different integration)
not_comparable: R750 / slope_750_1550 (lunar space weathering has no terrestrial analogue)
ASTER TIR silica/mafic indices (thermal infrared, not measured on the Moon here)
Sentinel-2 ferric ratio, NDVI (aqueous alteration / vegetation; absent on the Moon)
earth_analogs.disclaimer: Similarity of a few band-depth attributes. It is not a probability of mineral occurrence and does not indicate a deposit.
